items.description: A significant peat extraction site contributing to Rwanda's energy sector. It supports local power generation through thermal energy.
An important peat-to-power project helping to diversify Rwanda's energy mix. It plays a role in reducing dependence on imported fuels.
The first Volkswagen assembly plant in Rwanda, showcasing the country's growing automotive manufacturing industry. It operates as part of an integrated mobility solution.
An iconic skyscraper in the heart of Kigali serving as a commercial hub. It is one of the tallest and most recognizable buildings in the capital.
A historic Catholic church located in central Kigali. It has served the local community for decades and stands as a notable urban landmark.
A dedicated facility in Kigali providing recreational and educational activities for children. It offers a safe environment for development and play.
An outdoor area in Kigali designed to connect children with nature through guided play. It emphasizes environmental awareness and physical activity.
A popular riding center in Kigali offering equestrian training and pony rides for children. It provides a unique outdoor sporting experience.
A key sector in Akagera National Park where visitors can observe giraffes in their natural savanna habitat. It is a highlight for family wildlife tours.
An educational agricultural site near Huye where children can learn about farming practices and poultry care. It combines learning with hands-on experience.
A scenic lakeside beach in Rubavu known for its calm waters and family-oriented amenities. It is a preferred spot for relaxation along Lake Kivu.
An interactive center in Kigali focusing on science and technology education for younger generations. It uses hands-on exhibits to inspire interest in STEM.
A dormant volcano in the Virunga Mountains known for its steep slopes and diverse vegetation zones. It is a challenging destination for trekking enthusiasts.
An ancient, eroded volcano in the Virunga range offering unique biodiversity and high-altitude habitats. Its jagged peaks are a notable geographical feature.
A fragmented but ecologically vital forest patch known for its biodiversity. It serves as an important remnant of Rwanda's montane rainforest ecosystems.
